entries.title: Midjourney, the AI image generator, is developing a full-body ultrasonic scanner
entries.summary: Midjourney has announced its first hardware project, and it can do more than make cute AI pet photos.
entries.excerpt: Midjourney, known for its AI program that can generate images from text prompts, hasannouncedits new project: A medical machine that can scan your whole body in just 60 seconds. It's so far removed from what Midjourney is known for that we had to check the date and make sure it wasn't April 1st. Well, it's not April Fools: The Midjourney Scanner is real, and the company is even building spas where you can find the machines and get scanned.

entries.title: Epic Games details how it's embracing generative AI in Unreal Engine
entries.summary: Epic Games is making generative AI a big part of upcoming versions of Unreal Engine.
entries.excerpt: During The State of Unreal keynote at Unreal Fest on Wednesday, Epic Games revealed just how it's embracing generative AI in Unreal Engine (UE). Along with offering the first details onUnreal Engine 6 (UE6), the company discussed new features for Unreal Engine 5.8, which it also released on Wednesday. As part of the latest update, Epic is offering an experimental Model Context Protocol (MCP) plugin that will allow developers to hook gen AI models such as Claude and Gemini into Unreal Engine. It's looking to make the MCP an integral part of UE6.
